note: Protocol facts for each blueprint: its head of state, its head of government (or same_as_head_of_state where one person holds both offices), band (the office the band on the blueprint shows), its National Day and the offices that receive the National Day letters. The band shows the elected leader who runs the government (the Steward-General, 15 November 2026); both records are kept whichever it shows. Kept by the Blueprints Steward, who checks both offices once a month, and each nation again 15 days before its National Day. Portraits are supplied by the Steward-General: pn-hos-<nation> files for heads of state, pn-hog-<nation> files for heads of government, each with its credit and licence; until one is supplied the band shows the initials.
